spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:9:66: command demo: flag "token": sets `variable_file: APP_TOKEN_FILE`, a variable env password also reads; give the file form its own name
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:12:45: command demo: flag "plain": sets `variable_file` on a flag with no environment fallback; set `variable:` (or `key:`) so the flag reads an environment variable, then `variable_file` names its file form
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:15:61: command demo: flag "same": sets `variable_file: SAME`, which is also one of its own `variable` names; the file form needs its own name (by convention SAME_FILE)
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:20:72: command demo: env "labels": sets both `variable_file` and `nesting`; a nested input reads a family of variables, not one value a file could hold
